item.title: C++ HTTP Client Libraries: cpp-httplib vs cpr vs curlpp vs Boost.Beast
item.description: Every C++ application that calls REST APIs or downloads resources needs an HTTP client. But the C++ ecosystem offers radically different approaches: from header-only single-file libraries to C wrappers with C++ bindings to Boost-integrated solutions. This guide compares cpp-httplib, cpr, curlpp, and Boost.Beast across API design, dependency footprint, TLS support, and real-world performance.
